summary: Publish the Comic Book Scene maker as module 0.3.0 without mutating workflow files from the governor. The existing release workflow already packages the recursive assets, scripts, styles, and templates directories.

checks.name: Existing release workflow packages comic directories
checks.run: grep -q 'cp -R assets scripts styles templates' .github/workflows/release.yml && grep -q 'zip -r ../orphaned-sun-scenes.zip module.json README.md assets scripts styles templates' .github/workflows/release.yml

checks.name: Comic runtime files exist before release dispatch
checks.run: test -s scripts/comic-book-maker.mjs && test -s assets/comic/paper.svg && test -s assets/comic/frame.svg
